_status: assembled from public documentation; replace with the Feide Customer Portal export
_readme: Stand-in for docs/reference/feide-oidc-config.example.json (AUTH-001..AUTH-005). Public Feide/Dataporten endpoint values are evidenced in feide-values.md. HVL-specific values (clientId, granted attribute groups, registered redirect URIs, Feide realm) can only come from the Feide Customer Portal (kunde.feide.no) and are placeholders or proposals here. Never put a client secret in this file.
_redirectNotes: redirectUris are registered in the Customer Portal field 'Redirect URI after login'; postLogoutRedirectUris in 'Redirect URI for logout' (several URIs may be registered). postLogoutRedirectUris values are a PROPOSAL of this assembly (the server's logged-out page, /auth/logged-out), not taken from any source; the server sends <PUBLIC_BASE_URL>/auth/logged-out, so register exactly that. Feide permits plain-HTTP redirect URIs only for development; production must use HTTPS.

scopeDetails.openid: Required for OIDC (and for login_hint). With openid alone the token covers ALL attribute groups configured for the client; listing scopes explicitly narrows the token. 'openid' and 'userid' are authorised automatically when an OIDC configuration is added.
scopeDetails.userid: Auto-authorised; not requested explicitly here. The OIDC 'sub' claim is always present.
scopeDetails.profile: Standard scope. Releases 'name' only if attribute group userinfo-name is authorised, and 'picture' only if userinfo-photo is authorised. Recommendation: authorise userinfo-name only, never userinfo-photo.
scopeDetails.email: Releases 'email' (attribute group 'email'). 'email_verified' is always false because Feide does not verify addresses; never use e-mail as an identifier.
scopeDetails.userid-feide: Releases the Feide ID (eduPersonPrincipalName) as claim https://n.feide.no/claims/eduPersonPrincipalName and a 'feide:'-prefixed entry in https://n.feide.no/claims/userid_sec. Needed for every login: the Feide ID is the server's Feide subject, and a login without one is refused (D-054); also used for ADMIN_FEIDE_IDS.
scopeDetails.groups-org: Groups API: organisation group (type fc:org, id fc:org:<realm>) with membership.affiliation and membership.primaryAffiliation; org units (fc:orgunit). Needed for AUTH-002.
scopeDetails.groups-edu: Groups API: FS groups in higher education (course fc:fs:emne, programme of study fc:fs:prg, etc.) when the institution has the FS integration. Needed for AUTHOR_COURSE_GROUPS.
scopeDetails.userid-nin: NEVER request or authorise (AUTH-004). Would release https://n.feide.no/claims/nin (national identity number).

groupsApi._hvlRealmStatus: realm 'hvl.no' is taken from spec 02 and HVL's e-mail domain; it was NOT confirmed in a public Feide source (verify in the Customer Portal or with HVL IT)

loginHint._optional: Skips the organisation picker. Requires scope openid and the Customer Portal option 'Always require user interaction' to be unchecked. The S3 server sends no login_hint.

customerPortalFieldsToExport: Client secret (changeable; store as FEIDE_CLIENT_SECRET in the secret store, never here)
Client type (confidential per AUTH-001; the portal also offers 'Public', which requires PKCE)
Authorised attribute groups (userinfo-name, email, userid-feide, groups-org, groups-edu; NOT userinfo-photo, NOT userid-nin)
Login providers (Feide; disable Feide test users before production)
Restrict login to selected organizations (leave off if 'anyone with Feide' sharing is required by AUTH-002)
Always require user interaction (uncheck only if loginHint is used)
